messages:
Eve (Partnerships): Quick alignment for Interop Deep Dive next Wed — need final demo lanes, integrator office hours, embargo window, and co-branded swag list. Please confirm by EOD Mon. Link to runbook: https://drive.google.com/interop-deep-dive (comments only)
Priya (Marketing): I'll own the embargo text and partner comms. Proposal: embargo lifts Wed 3pm PT (30m after session). Partners ok?
Noah (Marketplace): AcmeCloud and VectorSI tentatively ok. Need marketplace listing blurb by Tue noon. I'll send draft.
Ken (Hardware PM): Hardware note: shipping 2 edge devkits + 1 rack node. Request foam cases and extra IEC leads. Also will prepare a 75s recorded fallback demo for each rig.
Liam (Eng): Demo order suggestion to avoid warm starts: 1) quick marketplace search (stateless), 2) on-device quantized demo (pre-warmed/container), 3) Dedicated cluster stress run (heavy). Keeps cold GPUs last.
Sam (Events): AV checklist: HDMI matrix, 2 lapels, 1 handheld, spare laptop. Need local router for isolated network. @SupplyBot confirm adapters & spares staged. Green room 25m prior.
SupplyBot: Staging inventory: HDMI adapters x8, USB-C adapters x6, lapel mics x2, handhelds x2, spare laptops x1, foam cases x2, IEC leads x3. Swag pallet TRK-66011 ETA Wed 07:00.
Eve (Partnerships): Swag plan: 09:30-12:30 sticker + postcard; 12:30-16:00 tees + sticker; last hour promo cards only. Volunteers: need 2 per shift. Priya can cover AM?
Priya (Marketing): Yes for 09:30-12:30. We'll set up an RSVP sheet for the integrator clinic (2x 20-min slots, max 10 each).
Noah (Marketplace): Fallback curl snippet for partners if Dedicated throttles — paste into runbook:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-lite-quant","prompt":"<prompt>","max_tokens":80}'
```
Ken (Hardware PM): I'll upload rig fallback clips by Tue 09:00 and a static slide set. Also requesting a locked cabinet backstage for devices.
Liam (Eng): Ops ask: can we get a reserved micro-VLAN for demo rigs? If not possible, we'll bring a pre-seeded router and run offline demos. Also will prepare a warmup job for the hosted fallback endpoint 30m pre-event.
Sam (Events): Venue said VLAN request is pending. I'll arrange local router as fallback and confirm power circuits (need dedicated 220V for rack).
Eve (Partnerships): One more — partners requested a short privacy blurb on each slide. Draft: "Demo inputs are synthetic or anonymized; no customer PII is recorded." Good?
Priya (Marketing): Good. I'll add to the title slide template. Also will make a partner-facing checklist: slide + 90s clip + contact for MC handoff.
SupplyBot: Courier update: swag pallet scanned TRK-66011 accepted, onsite staging confirmed.
Noah (Marketplace): Integrator clinic logistics: we'll offer two 20-min slots at 15:30 and 16:00. RSVP link will include 'what to bring' (sample prompts + laptop).
Eve (Partnerships): Great. Final: everyone add unresolved items as comments in the runbook. Dry-run Tue 16:00; green room 25m prior. Thanks :thumbsup:
